name: Swatch
description: The swatch alone: identity is a coloured mark beside text, never coloured text.
signature: ({ slot, tone, shape, hidden }: { slot?: number; tone?: string; shape?: SwatchShape; hidden?: boolean; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: hidden
props.description: Shows the swatch as switched off (its series is hidden); defaults to false.

props.name: shape
props.description: Mark shape to mirror; defaults to "box".

props.name: slot
props.description: Categorical slot 1–8; defaults to 1. Ignored when `tone` is set.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.
